- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.185.1/build/three.module.min.js

- three.core.min.js: 05b2609338c76cd65daf74f3ac515bc9a5045e1b3b33edc07d8c9bd55250fa90

The implementation follows the official [rendering-on-demand](https://threejs.org/manual/en/rendering-on-demand.html) and [resource cleanup](https://threejs.org/manual/en/cleanup.html) guidance. Update both files together and rerun the motion and browser checks when changing versions.
